A black card means disqualification for misconduct. The Umpire then calls 'Come here' to the offending player or pair followed by '… [name of player(s)], disqualified for misconduct' and a specific explanation of the misconduct, at the same time raising the right hand holding the black card above the Umpire's head (ITTO 5.17.5(2)-(4)). A disqualified player is disqualified from all events of the tournament and, in Team Tournaments, from all future matches of the Team Tournament (ITTO 3.6.2.2(1)).

Under Laws of Badminton 5.0 (2), in force 2025-04-26, Law 16.7.2(1), on faulting a side the umpire reports the offending side immediately to the Referee, who has the power to disqualify the offending side from the match — so the decision to disqualify, and hence to give the black card, belongs to the Referee, not the Umpire.
